note: Untied embeddings at the good operating point. Adds 388M params (+18.8%) for ZERO extra FLOPs -- tying changes which weights are used, not which matmuls run -- so unlike every other lever it cannot lose on throughput. Arm 18 measured dTGT/d(ln N) = -1.01, which extrapolates to -0.174 here, the largest win on the board. Against that: the 450-step arch sweep found untie LOSES (+0.089) because a freshly random lm_head cannot be learned in a short run, and 142 steps is shorter still. So this is a genuine coin-flip between the strongest prior and the strongest counter-prior.
